description: The purity boundary hides the hardest correctness obligation in the untested impure shell. classifyWorktree takes mergedIntoTrunk as a pre-computed boolean; PROP-003 trusts it. Computing mergedIntoTrunk correctly (squash, detached HEAD, wrong trunk) lives in probeWorktree, which has NO proof obligation. The most safety-critical value flows in as a trusted input with zero verification of its production. PROP-001..008 prove the easy half, leaving the dangerous half unproven.

evidence.snippet: `classifyWorktree(record: WorktreeRecord) → WorktreeStatus` | Evaluates all five ACTIVE predicates from plain-data input.

fix: Add Tier-1 integration PROPs that assert probeWorktree computes mergedIntoTrunk=false for a squash-merged-but-not-rev-list-merged branch, for detached HEAD, and for wrong/missing trunk. Pure-function tests are necessary but insufficient.
